### 0.1.3 Change Log
#### Global
##### Added
* Added world block selection for polishing workplaces and crank or valve standing positions.
* Added Blaze Burner fuel delivery with returned containers through existing item transport.
* Added configurable NPC editing distance in Mods Config, defaulting to 16 blocks.
* Added configurable melee knockback, overridden by BattleWorks when applied.
* Added Create seat targets with sneak-right-click selection to the day-cycle riding editor.
* Added a Create category with hand crank and valve day-cycle work settings.
* Added factory job editors with material lists, sensor thresholds and inspection targets.
##### Fixed
* Fixed startup and NPC editing crashes from missing or incompatible optional APIs.
* Fixed payment item selection without DRM while preserving item data and editor drafts.
* Fixed incompatible optional mixins preventing startup.
* Fixed Create block selectors accepting mismatched devices, unsupported sensors and non-storage blocks.
* Fixed NPC editing holds expiring while selecting Create job blocks.
* Fixed parcel source selection allowing an existing destination block.
* Fixed cross-dimension standing positions for Create crank and valve work.
* Fixed sandpaper polishing stalling when consuming the last material frees an inventory slot.
* Fixed NPC clones inheriting active Create delivery, seat ownership and completed work records.
* Fixed scheduled Create crank and valve inputs continuing while NPC AI is disabled.
* Fixed long schedule names being clipped instead of wrapping into taller rows.
* Fixed articulated elbow and wrist caps sampling shoulder or sleeve textures during Create work.
* Fixed repetitive torso rocking during day-cycle work while preserving custom poses.
* Fixed scheduled DRM JSON selection updating the wrong interaction bindings.
* Fixed position locking restoring previous seat positions after scheduled dismounting.
* Fixed extra melee knockback weakening existing movement and upward impulses.
* Fixed unnecessary dependency version restrictions blocking compatible mod installations.
* Fixed attack poses stopping before their complete swing animation played.
* Fixed malformed bed-selection requests exhausting the server stack during rejection.
* Fixed NPC cooking deliveries failing on containers with no input slots.
##### Improved
* Improved optional integration checks with cached capabilities and isolated failure handling.
* Improved standalone inventory picker labels and Korean localization.
* Improved Create block assignment instructions, target names, coordinates and clearing.
#### Forge 1.20.1 / Fabric & NeoForge 1.21.1
##### Fixed
* Fixed repeated melee attacks losing their swing animations.
* Fixed missing BattleWorks combat files leaving native NPC schedules and movement paused.
* Fixed optional DRM model types breaking NPC API inspection when DRM is absent.
* Fixed NPC clones inheriting previous BattleWorks summon ownership.
* Fixed one NPC ownership query failure disabling integration checks for other NPCs.
* Fixed invalid model JSON leaving stale profiles marked as current.
##### Improved
* Improved cooking recipe caching while preserving ingredient tag and datapack reload updates.
* Improved cooking integration performance by reusing device method lookups.
* Improved global settings synchronization by sharing serialized data across connected players.
#### Fabric & NeoForge 26.3
##### Fixed
* Fixed standalone item picker icons disappearing at reduced GUI scales.
* Fixed unsupported legacy conversion prompting for an unavailable dependency.
* Fixed mining and farming stalling when multiple NPCs search after world reloads.
* Fixed NPC clones inheriting previous BattleWorks summon ownership.
* Fixed one NPC ownership query failure disabling integration checks for other NPCs.
* Fixed invalid model JSON being retained as a successful cached profile.
##### Improved
* Improved cooking recipe caching while preserving ingredient tag and datapack reload updates.
* Improved cooking integration performance by reusing device method lookups.
* Improved global settings synchronization by sharing serialized data across connected players.
#### Forge 1.20.1 / NeoForge 1.21.1 / Fabric 26.3
##### Added
* Added sandpaper polishing with native Create recipes, tool wear and finished item delivery.
* Added addressed Create parcel delivery with recipient UUID routes and intact package returns.
* Added Stock Ticker attendance with native ordering, editor priority and scheduled seat departure.
* Added scheduled Create seat boarding, occupied-seat waiting and safe dismounting.
* Added seat tracking across contraption assembly, disassembly and server restarts.
* Added scheduled hand crank and valve operation with native Create rotation and stress.
* Added direction, timed cranking, valve repetitions and exclusive workstation access.
* Added articulated humanoid arms and continuous valve regripping during Create work.
* Added persistent completion records to prevent repeat work after server restarts.
* Added action sounds for Create cranking, polishing, valve operation and parcel handoffs.
* Added native factory processing with material batches, finished item collection and delivery.
* Added automatic material orders through Stock Ticker logistics with persistent request records.
* Added condition-driven hand crank, valve and Linked Controller operation.
* Added addressed parcel routes to receiving inventories with persistent delivery and return targets.
* Added factory inspections with native machine readings and reserved Display Board rows.
##### Fixed
* Fixed pending material orders losing received quantities after factory source changes.
* Fixed unrelated NPC inventory items incorrectly completing outstanding material orders.
* Fixed factory jobs using opposite double-chest halves as separate source and machine inventories.
* Fixed multiple factory workers reserving opposite halves of the same double chest.
* Fixed unstarted factory batches ignoring corrected machine targets and broken chest connections.
* Fixed completed valve inputs blocking new jobs after NPC dimension changes.
* Fixed full factory inventories intermittently displaying processing instead of capacity warnings.
* Fixed sealed Create parcels disappearing from NPC hands while being carried.
* Fixed parcel couriers climbing desks instead of approaching seated recipients from the floor.
* Fixed scheduled Create dismounts retaining elevated riding coordinates.
* Fixed native humanoid NPCs floating above static and moving Create seats.
##### Changed
* Changed Create valve workers to step back while facing their valve after finishing.
##### Improved
* Improved parcel carrying with a centered box and articulated grips in both hands.
#### Fabric 26.3
##### Fixed
* Fixed Create Fly belt extraction failing after simulated inventory reads.
#### Fabric & NeoForge 1.21.1
##### Fixed
* Fixed DRM trainer previews losing DNPC skins, models, and equipment.
#### Forge 1.20.1
##### Fixed
* Fixed missing mixin registration in Forge release JARs.
